nodes_changed.name: USER_AGENT
nodes_changed.doc:
Sent unless the request names its own. GitHub's API refuses a request

with no `User-Agent` (HTTP 403), which kept the image-freshness check

failing on every package from 2026-10-05.

nodes_changed.name: build
nodes_changed.signature: fn build(opts: &Map, whole_body: bool) -> Res<(String, Duration, reqwest::RequestBuilder)>
nodes_changed.doc:
The request `opts` describe, and its timeout. A streamed request

(`whole_body` false) applies the timeout to connecting only; the caller

bounds the wait for the headers.

nodes_changed.name: user_agent_echo
nodes_changed.doc:
An HTTP server for `requests` connections that answers each with the

request's `User-Agent` value, or `none`.
